items1.title: Malaria Pf/Pv Rapid Test Cassette (Whole Blood)
items1.sdesc: Rapid diagnostic test for Malaria Plasmodium falciparum and vivax
items1.ldesc: One-step rapid immunochromatographic test for qualitative detection of Plasmodium falciparum (Pf) and Plasmodium vivax (Pv) antigens in whole blood. Results in 15 minutes. Sensitivity: 98.5%, Specificity: 99.2%. Pack of 25 tests.

reviews.review: Extremely reliable in rural settings. Clear results every time.
Best malaria RDT we've used. Very low false positives.
Saved us countless hours. Highly recommended for outreach programs.

items1.title: COVID-19 Antigen Rapid Test (Nasal Swab)
items1.sdesc: Fast SARS-CoV-2 antigen detection in 15 minutes
items1.ldesc: WHO-approved rapid antigen test for detection of SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid protein. Nasal swab specimen. Clinical sensitivity: 96.8%, specificity: 99.9%. Includes all materials needed. Box of 20 tests.

reviews.review: Easy to administer and very accurate. Helped us keep the school open safely.
Reliable results, packaging is excellent.

items1.title: Digital Infrared Forehead Thermometer
items1.sdesc: Non-contact temperature measurement with fever alarm
items1.ldesc: Medical-grade non-contact infrared thermometer. Measures forehead temperature in 1 second. Accuracy ±0.2°C. Fever alarm, memory for 32 readings, backlit display. Suitable for home and clinical use.

reviews.review: Consistent readings matching our professional devices.
Easy for seniors to use independently.
